name: Crab Cakes
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 3, poissonier 3

Flavor Profiles umami, texture, salty
Additional Ingredients bitter, sour, spicy, sweet, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level or 1 minute when consumed; Serving Size 1d4+1
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

DESCRIPTION

Crab cakes typically combine fish (not always crab) with bread crumbs, mayonnaise, mustard, eggs, and seasonings into a patty that is then cooked to local tastes.

When consumed, it gives a circumstance penalty to combat maneuver checks equal to the culinarian’s Intelligence or Wisdom modifier (if positive) for 1 minute.

Additional ingredients increase the penalty by –1, and the serving size by +1.

Additional bitter or sour ingredients each deal 1d6 acid damage on a failed save.

Additional spicy ingredients also deal 1d6 fire damage on a failed save.

S-Class Characters: The Culinarian © 2023, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
